import Clock from "@/components/widgets/clock.svelte";

Opening paragraph. The `title` above becomes the page `<h1>`, so start body
headings at `##`.

## A static component

Rendered on the server, no JavaScript shipped:

<Clock />

## An interactive component

Hydrated only when it scrolls into view:

<Clock client:visible />

Astro components work the same way — import them with the `@/` alias and use
them as tags; they never ship JavaScript.
